entities.summary: The Stade Bauer is a football stadium in Saint-Ouen-sur-Seine in the northern suburbs of Paris. The stadium is mainly used by Red Star F.C. who currently play in Ligue 2 from 2024 to 2025 but have tasted success in the Coupe de France, winning it on five occasions.
